retraction.reason: Retracted in M40b: the war between the army and the Rapid Support Forces since April 2023. The atlas holds nothing in Sudan. It has no record of the Darfur war the RSF came out of, none of the revolution of 2019, and none of the secession of South Sudan, and there is no Portuguese link. It would need the Sudanese revolution, or Darfur, as a record before anybody could write an honest edge from either end.

title: Sudanese civil war
